findings.reason: The frozen standalone tiles show only algebraic prose for two distinct orthogonal splittings. A schematic block figure materially clarifies which deterministic subspace carries each independent Gaussian block and how the nested-model residual splits into the F numerator and denominator; it also displays the zero-dimensional reduced-space boundary without suggesting positive dimension. This is a warranted explanatory addition under the expanded diagram scope.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: Top row: W=col(X) and W-perp in R^n; Q:R^p -> W and Q_0:R^(n-p) -> W-perp are the orthonormal-column isometries chosen in step 1.1. The projection maps have domains R^n and codomains their respective labelled summands.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: Step 1.1 gives R^n=W direct-sum W-perp and dimensions p,n-p. Step 2.1 gives P_W epsilon=sigma Q Z_Q and P_(W-perp) epsilon=sigma Q_0 Z_0, independent Z_Q,Z_0, and RSS_X/sigma^2=norm(Z_0)^2 with chi-square n-p law. No claim that subspaces are random or that fitted coordinates have zero mean is made.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: Bottom row: deterministic W_R subset W_U, W_D=W_U intersect W_R-perp, and W_U-perp. P_R:R^n -> W_R, P_(W_D):R^n -> W_D and P_(W_U-perp):R^n -> W_U-perp are the orthogonal projections defined by the local orthogonal-projection supplier.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: Step 4.1 proves the pairwise orthogonal direct sum R^n=W_R direct-sum W_D direct-sum W_U-perp and dimensions p-q,q,n-p. Orthogonal Gaussian coordinates give independence of all three projected error blocks. Under the stated null only, P_(W_D)Y=P_(W_D)epsilon and P_(W_U-perp)Y=P_(W_U-perp)epsilon; Pythagoras yields their squared norms RSS_R-RSS_U and RSS_U. Dividing by sigma^2 gives the chi-square q and n-p labels. For q=p, W_R={0} and its projection is identically zero. The picture has no morphism arrows, crossings, or geometric angles asserting additional relations.
